Delicious snail and seafood restaurant on Bui Vien west street, District 1, sparkling lanterns as bright as in the Northwest - Sapa
Aug 2023 • Family
Snails and fresh seafood are the choice for tourists who love fresh seafood

5* review of seafood restaurant Oc and fresh seafood is the choice for tourists who love seafood + Bui Vien Western street + delicious restaurants:

I am very pleased to share with you my wonderful experience at Oc seafood and fresh seafood restaurant on Tay Bui Vien street. This is a place that I cannot help but mention when talking about seafood lovers, not only because of the rich menu but also because of the space and quality service.

First of all, Oc Dai Viet restaurant's menu and fresh seafood really impressed me. They offer a wide range of fresh seafood dishes such as shrimp, crabs, crabs, scallops and many other types of seafood. I can choose from grilled, steamed, stir-fried, roasted or prepared dishes based on traditional Vietnamese dishes. Seafood is fresh, delicious and meticulously prepared. In particular, I am quite impressed with the live seafood that can be picked directly from the aquarium, providing a great experience and quality assurance.

In addition, the restaurant space is also very impressive. Decorated in a modern and luxurious style, but still imbued with Vietnamese tradition. The space creates a comfortable and cozy feeling, suitable for family gatherings or meeting friends. The service staff is very friendly and professional. They are always willing to help and advise on dishes that suit customers' tastes.

Finally, the Snail and fresh seafood restaurant is located in the vibrant Western Bui Vien street neighborhood of Saigon night.
